items.detail: Ladies Night Out: Harvest & Holiday A Mt. Prospect Parks Foundation Fundraiser! items.detail: Mt. Prospect Fitness Dri-Tri Welcome to the Dry Triathlon, no water required! Row 2,000 meters, air bike 2.5 miles, and run 1 mile on the track. Participants complete each segment consecutively, with total time recorded by staff. Each participant will be assigned a designated heat time before the event. Heats begin every 30 minutes, starting at 8:00 AM and running through 11:30 AM, with four participants per heat. Assigned heat times cannot be adjusted. Every triathlete receives an event shirt and refreshments! R $35 NR $45 Click here to register!

items.detail: Winter Seed Sowing Workshop (Ages 18+) Get a headstart on your spring garden with our new winter sowing workshop. Winter sowing is an awesome alternative to growing plants inside your home and is best for native seeds that benefit from cold stratification. This method is an easy way to start up your spring garden even when it’s still snowing. All materials supplied! R $26 NR $28 Click here to register!
